purpose: One record per owner under active reconstruction. The neighboring C is preserved as a source hypothesis; neither the C nor this record claims ROM ownership. Measurements are edition-qualified, and exactness is awarded separately for every edition.
rules: The record filename is its owner identity. Human names come only from games/gs1/source-paths.json; records do not repeat either field.
A record remains useful after one edition becomes exact when it describes correspondence or a different edition's delta.
`score` is what the tools actually reported, with the date. `check recon --verify` recompiles and refuses a record whose score has drifted.
`unexpressed` is the work left in the measured edition, in instruction counts read off that reference.
`rejected` exists so nobody repeats a measured dead end. Every entry carries the number that killed it.
